macade.desc: A zip bomber sweater shaped for cold evenings and elevated club settings, the Downs Wool Bomber sits in a relaxed fit with set-in sleeves and a composed, structured drape. Four-way stretch moves easily through wear, while the heavy jersey fabric lends a soft interior and a substantial feel. Finished with a multi-striped ribbed collar, cuffs and hem.

The Flow Light Bomber Neck is knitted with a close, clean silhouette for easy layering. It's made from a ThermoCool & Extrafine Merino Wool blend, with a hollow, dual-direction thermoregulating core that pulls moisture away from the skin while helping retain warmth. Lightweight with four-way stretch and cut in a regular fit, it moves naturally through the swing and holds its shape wash after wash.

Knitted in a soft cotton and cashmere blend, the Club Knit Polo sweater is built for changing weather and cooler rounds. The relaxed fit and four-way stretch yarn move naturally through the swing, while the knit carries enough weight to work as a layer on its own. Easy to live in and built to hold its shape long after the season turns.

macade.t: Hayes Long Sleeve Zip Polo - Brown
macade.desc: A long-sleeve zip polo made for cold rounds and refined club hours, the Hayes Long Sleeve Zip Polo sits in a regular fit with set-in sleeves and a structured drape. Four-way stretch supports full movement through the swing, while the heavy jersey construction carries a soft inside touch and a substantial hand-feel.

These pleated trousers are cut from a midweight Ridgeweave woven blend with mechanical four-way stretch, structured where it counts and flexible where it matters. The breathable construction carries you through long, hot rounds, while the relaxed fit and clean pleats keep the silhouette polished. Modern golf tailoring with a refined edge.

Engineered for cold-weather golf, this beanie combines warmth and performance in a minimal design. Its stretchy, soft material provides a snug, comfortable fit while keeping you protected from the elements. A must-have for cold-weather rounds.

rookline.desc: Most cashmere waits for a special occasion. 8:04 on a fall Sunday morning qualifies. Knit from 100% cashmere, The Ottoman Rib Crewneck balances warmth and breathability the way only cashmere can. A fully fashioned saddle sleeve and Ottoman rib detail at the elbow, cuff and hem add structure and a quiet point of distinction. Wear it more than you think you should.

Strike the balance. Light enough for a cool morning on the course. Composed for the fork and knife afterwards. An intentional blend of cotton and cashmere gives the Signature Blend Polo warmth without sacrificing breathability. Categorically a longsleeve polo. Worn more like a sweater. You’ll love playing golf in this.

You rarely get eighteen of the same thing. The Pivot Pant leaves room to adjust to bad lies and changes in the wind. Japanese cotton twill with 3% spandex moves without sacrificing shape. These pants are a modest compromise between slim and wide, performance and lifestyle, in both fit and feel. No need to adjust. The pant already has.

Watch caps were issued to sailors standing watch: hours on deck, in the dark, in weather, with nothing to do but pay attention. Ours is knit from 100% cashmere, two ends of yarn twisted into one for density and a cap that survives a season of being pulled on and shoved in a pocket. Deploy on dreich mornings waiting for the frost to burn.
